title: Not what you've signed up for: Compromising Real-World LLM-Integrated Applications with Indirect Prompt Injection
inspection_note: 本人亲读p1Abstract/§1：overrideoriginalinstructions、data/instructionsboundary、retrieveddata中注入定义；仅本toy机制，不迁realworld防御成效。
quote: Prompt Injection (PI) attacks enable attackers to override original instructions and employed controls. ... LLM-Integrated Applications blur the line between data and instructions. ... strategically injecting prompts into data likely to be retrieved.
